detail.longDescription: PyCharm keeps asking me for the login or a token. Is there a way to disable this prompt? Even when I do log in using a token the prompt reappears after a while. I am not even using PyCharm to clone, pull or push repos. I am doing that in the terminal. And even those functions should not require a login when SSH is configured, right? I am launching PyCharm from the terminal, so it should have the SSH keys in the environment. Or what am I missing? I have seen PyCharm Asking for GitHub Login but that's kind of different and 4 years old.
